items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA Deepens Korea AI Ecosystem with SK Group $500B+ Factories, NAVER Expansion and SNU AI Technology Center
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 深化韓國 AI 生態系：與 SK 集團逾 5000 億美元工廠合作、NAVER 擴建與首爾大學 AI 技術中心
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA announced a $500-billion-plus partnership with SK Group spanning AI factories and next-generation memory, including a 2-gigawatt NVIDIA Vera Rubin DSX AI Factory to be built by SK Telecom (powered by SK hynix HBM, targeted 2027). Separately, NAVER, NVIDIA and Brookfield are expanding Korea’s national AI factory infrastructure to 200 megawatts at GAK Sejong. On July 25 NVIDIA also introduced the NVIDIA AI Technology Center at Seoul National University.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 宣布與 SK 集團展開逾 5000 億美元合作，涵蓋 AI 工廠與次世代記憶體，包括由 SK Telecom 興建的 2GW NVIDIA Vera Rubin DSX AI 工廠（採 SK hynix HBM，目標 2027 年）。另與 NAVER、Brookfield 擴建韓國國家 AI 工廠至 200MW。7 月 25 日進一步宣布於首爾大學設立 NVIDIA AI 技術中心。
items_flat.analysis_en: These coordinated deals highlight intensifying sovereign AI infrastructure competition in Asia and NVIDIA’s full-stack lock-in strategy across compute, memory and talent. Execution risk remains on power, timelines and actual capacity delivery.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些協調性協議凸顯亞洲主權 AI 基礎設施競爭加劇，以及 NVIDIA 在運算、記憶體與人才的全棧鎖定策略。執行風險仍在於電力供應、時程與實際產能交付。
items_flat.quote: Korea isn't just an NVIDIA partner anymore. It's where the next wave of AI gets built and SNU is at the center of it. Introducing the NVIDIA AI Technology Center at @SeoulNatlUni.
items_flat.quote_zh: 「韓國不再只是 NVIDIA 的合作夥伴。這裡是下一波 AI 被打造的地方，而首爾大學正處於中心。宣布於首爾大學設立 NVIDIA AI 技術中心。」

items_flat.title_en: Demis Hassabis Affirms Support for Strong Open AI Ecosystem
items_flat.title_zh: Demis Hassabis 重申支持強大且安全的開源 AI 生態系
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis posted on X that a strong and secure open ecosystem is important for the world to benefit from AI. He highlighted DeepMind’s contributions including Jax, Transformers, AlphaFold and Gemma models (Gemma 4 models have been downloaded 300M+ times; the Gemma series as a whole 900M+).
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis 於 X 發文表示，強大且安全的開源生態系對世界從 AI 獲益至關重要。他強調 DeepMind 的貢獻包括 Jax、Transformers、AlphaFold 與 Gemma 模型（Gemma 4 逾 3 億下載，系列逾 9 億）。
items_flat.analysis_en: This restates Google’s consistent open-source posture amid the open-versus-closed policy debate. Uncertainty remains on how regulators will weigh open-model contributions against potential misuse risks.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這重申了 Google 在開源與封閉政策辯論中一貫的開源立場。監管機構如何權衡開源模型貢獻與潛在濫用風險仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: A strong and secure open ecosystem is important for the world to benefit from AI. We’ve always supported and contributed heavily to open source and science from Jax to Transformers to AlphaFold to Gemma open models which have now been downloaded 300M+ times.
items_flat.quote_zh: 「強大且安全的開源生態系對世界從 AI 獲益至關重要。我們一直大力支持並貢獻開源與科學，從 Jax、Transformers、AlphaFold 到 Gemma 開源模型，目前已累計下載逾 3 億次。」

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Provides Update on Hugging Face Security Incident Review
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 更新 Hugging Face 安全事件審查進度
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI stated it recognizes questions and speculative details circulating about the Hugging Face incident, calling it an unprecedented event that marks an important moment for AI safety. The company is conducting a thorough review with external advisors and oversight from its Safety and Security Committee, and plans to publish a technical report of its learnings in the coming weeks.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示已注意到圍繞 Hugging Face 事件的疑問與推測細節，稱此為前所未有的事件，標誌 AI 安全的重要時刻。公司正與外部顧問及安全與安全委員會監督進行徹底審查，計畫在未來數週發布技術報告。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a procedural update rather than new technical disclosure. The forthcoming report will be the key test of how much concrete containment and alignment insight the industry gains from the agentic cyber incident.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是程序性更新而非新技術揭露。即將到來的報告將是產業從這次 agentic 網路事件中能獲得多少具體遏制與對齊洞見的關鍵考驗。
items_flat.quote: This is an unprecedented incident, and we think it marks an important moment for AI safety. We are still conducting a thorough review along with external advisors and with oversight from our Safety and Security Committee. Once the review is complete, we plan to publish a technical report of our learnings in the coming weeks.
items_flat.quote_zh: 「這是前所未有的事件，我們認為它標誌著 AI 安全的重要時刻。我們仍在與外部顧問及安全與安全委員會監督下進行徹底審查。審查完成後，我們計畫在未來數週發布技術報告。」

No new flagship model releases.
